features: [1GB RAM & 8GB Storage for Everyday Entertainment] - Enjoy smooth access to your favorite compatible apps, videos, and media with 1GB RAM and 8GB of built-in storage, giving you space for essential content and everyday use.

description: Upgrade your home entertainment setup with the i96 Android TV Box, a compact media player designed to bring your favorite content to the big screen. With 1GB RAM and 8GB of internal storage, it provides space for supported apps and multimedia files, making everyday entertainment simple and convenient. Enjoy clear and vibrant visuals with Full HD 1080P video support, ideal for watching compatible videos, movies, and other media on your TV. Dual-band WiFi helps provide flexible wireless connectivity, while Bluetooth 5.0 allows you to pair compatible accessories such as speakers, keyboards, mice, and other supported devices. The i96 Android TV Box is equipped with multiple connectivity options, including HDMI, USB, LAN, AV, IR, and a Micro SD card slot, making it easy to connect a variety of compatible devices and external storage solutions. Its compact design fits neatly into any entertainment space, transforming compatible televisions and displays into versatile multimedia centers for media playback, web browsing, and supported Android applications.
